AJAY KUMAR CHAUDHARI

Mobile: +91- 9768091643 mEmail ID: ajaymit007@yahoo.com | Linkedin: www.linkedin.com/in/ajaykchaudhari | Location: Pune

SUMMARY

Product Owner with 13+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale product strategy, digital transformation, and regulatory initiatives across Payments, Wholesale Banking, and Retail Banking domains. Proven expertise in delivering complex payment solutions including Cross-Border Payments, ACH, Wire Transfers, SWIFT MT/MX Messaging, ISO 20022 Migration, Clearing & Settlement, and Real-Time Payment ecosystems.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology in Information Technology, 2006-2010, from Uttar Pradesh Technical University, UP

CORE SKILLS

✓ Key Skills - Product Ownership & Product Strategy | SAFe Agile | Scrum | RTB | CTB | Product Roadmap |

Program Increment (PI) Planning | Business Analysis | Requirement Management | Epic | User Story Creation & Acceptance Criteria | Product Backlog and Refinement | Product Demo | Stakeholder and Executive Management | Cross-Functional Team Leadership | RAID Management | Risk Management

✓ Domain Expertise - Wholesale Banking | Issuer Services | Retail Banking | Payments - Cross-Border

Payments, Real-Time Payments (RTP), ACH & Wire Payments | ISO 20022 Migration & Transformation - SWIFT MT/MX Messaging | Clearing & Settlement | Fintech

✓ Delivery & Transformation - End to End Product Delivery | UAT Coordination and Sign-off | Change Management | Workflow Automation | Data Analysis and Reporting | KPI & Performance Metrics

✓ Business Transformation & Architecture -AS-IS / TO-BE Analysis | Target Operating Model (TOM) | Business Process Mapping | Process Re-engineering | Business Capability Mapping | Process Optimization | Transformation Roadmaps | Customer Journey Mapping | Gap Analysis | Operating Model Transformation

✓ Tools, Technology & Products - JIRA | Confluence | MS Visio | MS Office Suite | Generative AI | API Integration | | JSON/XML payloads and Validations | SQL | Database | ERP | CRM | FINNONE | VMS | ODYSSEY| RET

ORGANIZATIONAL EXPERIENCE

Virtusa Consulting Service Private Limited | Pune 1. Client – CITI Bank | Product Owner | (October 2025 to Till Now)

October2021-Present

Key Roles: ✓ Responsible for CITI Global Regulatory Event Tracking product ownership and strategy including defining

product vision, roadmap and strategic objectives.

✓ Actively participated in PI planning activities and all scrum ceremonies. ✓ Facilitating requirement workshops, peer discussion and gathering detailed requirements from multiple

stakeholders.

✓ Translating regulatory requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.

✓ Generative AI Use Case Identification for RET Product. ✓ Responsible for backlog refinements and prioritization. ✓ Act as primary bridge between business stakeholders, development and delivery team. ✓ Collaborate closely with engineering team to remove critical blockers, and ensure timely delivery of features. ✓ Supporting UAT to ensure successful feature delivery. ✓ Coordinate with other POs, Scrum Masters, and the Release Train Engineer (RTE) across the Agile Release Train

(ART) to manage cross team dependencies mitigate the risks.

✓ Document and maintain product artifacts like Steer-co, RAID log etc. ✓ Tracking production issues, identify root cause and coordinating with support team for issue resolution. ✓ Tracking KPIs and accomplishments and delivery milestones. ✓ Strong exposure to both Change-the-Bank (CTB) and Run-the-Bank (RTB) operating models, with a sound

appreciation of production stability, operational controls, and risk management

✓ Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to

engage confidently with senior business stakeholders, technology leads, and external partners.

2. Client – HSBC | Agile Business Analyst | (October 2021 to October 2025)

Key Roles: ✓ Facilitated requirements workshops and prepared functional requirements documents, working closely

with Product, Business and Technology stakeholders.

✓ Gathered requirements and created user stories, use cases, process flows and mock-ups. ✓ Performed functional testing and facilitated UAT with business users; conducted walkthroughs and

supported SIT/UAT execution.

✓ Performed gap analysis and developed roadmaps for application enhancements and transformation

initiatives.

✓ Supported Target Operating Model (TOM) transformation for payment processing, defining future-state process responsibilities, business/technology hand-offs, operational controls and system interactions across payment initiation, processing, clearing and settlement.

✓ Conducted detailed AS-IS process analysis across cross-border payments, ACH, Wire, SWIFT and ISO

20022 payment flows, documenting current-state processes, business rules, system interactions, hand-offs and operational pain points.

✓ Performed AS-IS vs. TO-BE gap analysis to identify process, system, data and operational gaps and

translated findings into business requirements, user stories and transformation initiatives.

✓ Designed and documented TO-BE process flows for payment migration and automation initiatives,

identifying process simplification opportunities, changes in system responsibilities and opportunities to improve straight-through processing.

✓ Performed Business Capability Mapping for payment transformation initiatives, linking payment

capabilities across initiation, validation, processing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation and exception management to supporting processes and technology components.

✓ Led requirements workshops for critical banking transformation projects including US Transtar Migration, Cross-Border Payments, ACH, Wire, SWIFT, CT Account Automation, Repack Reporting, ISO 20022/SWIFT Migration, DTCC and clearing-house initiatives.

Key Deliverables:

✓ Supported legacy-to-target platform transformation by analysing AS-IS processes, identifying functional and operational gaps, defining TO-BE workflows and translating target-state requirements into business/user stories while addressing customer, regulatory and compliance requirements. Implemented US payment solutions covering ACH and Wire, along with ISO 20022-aligned corporate-action messaging across HK, UK, US and Singapore.

✓

✓ Led functional analysis for cross-border payment and cash-account automation, mapping AS-IS payment flows and defining TO-BE workflows across SWIFT messaging, HUB-Hadoop integration and Odyssey, including business rules, system interactions, exception handling and operational hand-offs. Implemented cross-border payment flows involving MT103 and MT202 and supported cash-account automation through HUB-Hadoop/Odyssey integration.

✓

CMS IT Service Private Limited | Mumbai 1. Client – ICICI HFC | Business Analyst | (October 2018 to July 2021)

October2018–July2021

Key Roles: ✓ Led requirements workshops, translating complex business needs into functional specifications for

critical banking projects like Loan Origination & Servicing, Customer On boarding, Vendor Management System.

✓ Facilitating requirements workshops and preparing business requirements documents. ✓ Working closely with technology and business stakeholders to ensure the project deliverables. ✓ Responsible for creating Use Stories and Use Cases, Sequence Flow, and DFDs. ✓ Performing functional testing and facilitating user acceptance testing (UAT) with business user. ✓ Facilitating end user training & centralized user management activity and master data management. ✓ Performing gaps analysis and devising a road map for enhancing applications & ensuring a

smooth implementation.

✓ Mapped AS-IS customer onboarding and lending processes, identifying manual activities, process gaps and system dependencies and defining TO-BE workflows for digital onboarding, eligibility checks, approvals and loan disbursement.

✓ Designed future-state payment processing workflows for the Vendor Management System, covering UPI-

based domestic payments, validation, approval and downstream processing.

✓ Responsible for production support activity and deployments. ✓ Successfully delivered digital solutions resulting in measurable cost savings and improved process

transparency.

Key Deliverables:

✓ Mapped the end-to-end customer onboarding journey for the HFC Mobility application, covering

customer acquisition, eligibility checks, approval and loan disbursement, and identified process

improvements to support a smoother digital experience.

✓ Delivered HFC Vendor management system that on boarded 5000+ sales & channel partners and managed their sales, invoice and domestic payment solutions including UPI, collaborating with

cross-functional teams to define end-to-end payment processing .

✓ Maintained master data mapping for various application like APS / Finnone / VMS / FMCANVAS / CRMnext.

✓ Hands-on experience working on different rule engines and process automation tools and techniques.

Destar Infotech Limited | Mumbai Business Analyst ✓ Designed and implemented change management strategies that improve adoption rates and delivered

April2018–July2018

the enhance version of CRM application to various clients.

PG Advisory Services (P) Limited | Mumbai Business Analyst

January2017–November2017

✓ Conducted in-depth business research, process mapping, and gap analysis to support program

objectives. Applied design thinking methodologies to define innovative solutions addressing customer and business needs.

✓ Led requirement lifecycle management ensuring complete traceability and alignment to business goals.

ITAakash Strategic Software (P) Limited | Mumbai Business Analyst ✓ Led implementation planning and execution to ensure smooth implementation, service quality and

June2014–January2017

✓

risk mitigation. Implemented ERP and CRM solution for multiple clients and post implementation support.

Pinga Solutions (P) Limited | Noida Functional Consultant ✓ Delivered real estate CRM solution for multiple clients and supported post implementation issues.

December2010–May2013
